Classes for Every Age

Our Programs

Training that grows with your family — building focus, confidence, and real self-defense skills at every age.

Ages 3-5

Little Ninjas

Small children learn safety, coordination, and confidence through fun, age-appropriate drills. We teach awareness, boundaries, and strong voices in a positive, playful environment.

★★★★★ Parent Approved Learn More
Ages 6-17

Youth Martial Arts

Kids and teens develop confidence, discipline, and real self-defense skills in a structured, encouraging environment. Perfect for improving focus, standing up to bullies, and building healthy habits that carry home and into school.

★★★★★ Parent Approved Learn More
Ages 18+

Adult Classes

Whether you're training for fitness, self-defense, or stress relief, our adult classes offer expert instruction in a welcoming, beginner-friendly environment. Train at your own pace and build lasting confidence and strength.

Next-Level Opportunities

From Sparring Class to Competition Excellence

Help students channel disciplined training into high-impact experiences that showcase precision, confidence, and competitive spirit.

Orange Belt Milestone

SPARRING CLASS

Students who reach the rank of orange belt are able to begin sparring.

LSIT students and instructors apply techniques learned during class in a controlled and structured sparring environment.

Competitive Track

COMPETITION & TOURNAMENTS

Are you a competitor?

Lone Star Institute of Taekwondo is a proud member of the Texas Karate League, Texas State Taekwondo Association, and USA Taekwondo.

LSIT students and instructors compete regularly in local, state, and national competitions in both poomsae (forms) and gyoroogi (sparring).

The Five Tenets of Taekwondo

예의

Courtesy

Ye-wee

Courtesy (예의, ye-wee) reminds us to show respect in the dojang and beyond through sincere etiquette and kindness.

염치

Integrity

Yom-chee

Integrity (염치, yom-chee) calls for honesty, strong morals, and the courage to do what is right even when it is difficult.

인내

Perseverance

Een-nay

Perseverance (인내, een-nay) is the willingness to keep pushing toward every goal despite obstacles in training or life.

극기

Self Control

Gook-gee

Self control (극기, gook-gee) keeps thoughts, emotions, and actions in balance so we can respond with a steady mind and body.

백절불굴

Indomitable Spirit

Baekjool Boolgool

Indomitable spirit (백절불굴, baekjool boolgool) is to be defeated a hundred times yet never bent — the heart of true strength.
